segments.title: The HELL CHICKEN ate... fruit?
segments.say: This dinosaur's nickname is the hell chicken. And it probably ate fruit.

segments.title: About turkey-sized
segments.say: It was about the size of a turkey, with a toothless beak.

segments.title: Found in Montana
segments.say: Its skull was found in Montana, in rocks called Hell Creek.

segments.title: A jaw that SLID
segments.say: Its jaw slid back and forth to mash food, like a parrot's.

segments.title: First fruit-eating dino?
segments.say: Scientists think it may be the first known fruit eating dinosaur.

segments.title: Source: Nature Communications
segments.say: The study is in Nature Communications.
